title: PatchTST: Patch-based tokenisation restores transformer competitiveness over linear baselines on ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm1
abstract: We study long-horizon multivariate forecasting using PatchTST, a patch-based channel-independent transformer. On ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm1, at horizon 336, Patch-based tokenisation restores transformer competitiveness over linear baselines on ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm1. PatchTST improves MSE by an average of 20% over DLinear across 4 datasets. We discuss two limitations: Evaluation is restricted to public benchmarks and may not reflect production settings. Reported gains use a single held-out split; results across seeds vary by more than the headline MSE difference. Future work should address extending the evaluation to include dlinear and nlinear as baselines. and reporting per-seed variance and confidence intervals for the headline metric.
